title: Menelik Palace

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged Terrarium sample at the public historic complex between the mapped imperial halls.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Great Ghebbi heritage buildings
mapIdentity.scope: The four independently named current building ways supply the footprints and relative siting. Native shapes retain the angles, offsets and notches that distinguish the four buildings.

note: The two public-domain ETH Library originals were matched to the published Qualla images and show the complex in 1934. The photographs distinguish wings, several sheet-roof planes and the ornate domed mausoleum. Current mapped polygons control the standing footprints.
